title: Bonus Awards and Purchased Points in the Wanderlane Traveller Club
content:
Four awards on a Wanderlane Traveller Club card arrive outside the ordinary earn rate, and purchased points arrive by a fifth route that is not an award at all.

**The milestone bonus** is paid once in a qualifying period, at the moment the milestone threshold is passed, and is not paid again if the count later falls back.

**The birthday bonus** is paid once a membership year.

**The referral bonus** is paid on each enrolled referral up to the tier's annual cap; a referral that never activates is not paid.

**Purchased points** accrue nothing further: they arrive spendable, they do not earn the tier bonus, and they never count toward qualification.

## Points of judgement for the desk

*A member passes the milestone threshold in the fourth month of a qualifying period and the bonus is paid. Later in the same period a correction takes the qualifying count back below the threshold, and later still the count passes the threshold again.* The bonus is not paid a second time. It is paid once in a qualifying period, at the moment the threshold is passed, and is not paid again if the count later falls back.

*A member referred several new travellers, and one of them enrolled but the card was never activated.* The referrals that enrolled and activated are paid up to the tier's annual cap for that calendar year; the referral that never activates is not paid.

*A member asks whether the points they bought will attract the tier bonus, and whether they will help them hold their tier.* Neither. Purchased points arrive spendable, they do not earn the tier bonus, and they never count toward qualification.

*A member's birthday falls twice inside one long membership year.* The birthday bonus is paid once a membership year.

## The four awards side by side

| Award | How often it is paid | What it is measured against |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Milestone bonus | Once in a qualifying period | The qualifying count passing the tier's milestone threshold |
| Birthday bonus | Once a membership year | The member's birthday |
| Referral bonus | On each enrolled referral, up to the tier's annual cap | Each new member referred and enrolled |
| Purchased points | Not an award; bought by the member | Nothing further accrues on them |
